q1.question: Does Dobify work without internet?
q1.answer: Yes. Dobify is offline-first — sales, inventory changes and checkouts keep working locally and sync automatically once you're back online.

q2.question: What devices does Dobify run on?
q2.answer: Dobify runs on Android, iOS, web and desktop, so you can use existing tablets, phones or computers at the counter.

q3.question: Can I manage more than one location?
q3.answer: Yes. Growth and Enterprise plans support unlimited locations with reporting broken down by store.

q4.question: Is there a free trial?
q4.answer: Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

q5.question: How do I migrate from my current POS?
q5.answer: We offer free migration assistance. Export your products as CSV and our team will help import everything within 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to Dobify. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our multi-tenant point-of-sale (POS) platform and related services.

section1.title: Information We Collect
section1.intro: To provide our point-of-sale services, we collect:

item1.label: Account Information:
item1.text: Name, email address, business details, and contact information.

item2.label: Transaction Data:
item2.text: Details regarding sales, products, inventory, and receipts processed through the platform.

item3.label: Device & Usage Data:
item3.text: Information about the hardware and operating systems used to access Dobify, to ensure cross-platform compatibility and synchronization.

section2.title: How We Use Your Information
section2.intro: We use the collected information to:

item1.text: Operate and maintain your POS system and database synchronization.

item2.text: Process payments securely and facilitate merchant verification flows.

item3.text: Provide technical support and platform updates.

section3.title: Payment Processing and Third-Party Services
section3.intro: Dobify does not directly store sensitive credit card information on our servers. We partner with secure, industry-leading third-party services:

item1.label: Stripe & Payment Gateways:
item1.text: We utilize pre-built embedded components from Stripe to securely handle merchant onboarding, verification, and payment processing.

item2.label: Tap to Pay & Point of Sale:
item2.text: For in-person transactions, we support Tap to Pay features and terminal integrations via Stripe. Transaction data is encrypted and passed directly to the payment processor.

item3.label: Google Play Services & Apple:
item3.text: Used to manage app releases, subscriptions, and platform analytics for mobile users.

section4.title: Data Retention and Deletion
section4.intro: You have the right to request the complete deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time.

howTo.label: How to Request Deletion
howTo.text: You can request account deletion directly within the Dobify app by navigating to your Account Settings, or by emailing us at privacy{'@'}dobify.com.

whatHappens.label: What Happens to Your Data
whatHappens.text: Upon receiving a deletion request, we will permanently remove your account profile, device data, and personal identifiers from our active databases. Certain historical transaction records may be retained temporarily in an anonymized format to comply with mandatory financial reporting and local tax law requirements.

section5.title: Data Security
section5.text: We implement strict architectural and database-level security measures to protect your data across our multi-tenant environment. However, no electronic transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be entirely secure.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have questions regarding this policy or your data rights, please contact us at:

q1.question: How do I reset my password?
q1.answer: Go to the login screen and tap 'Forgot password'. Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.

q2.question: Can I use Dobify on multiple devices?
q2.answer: Yes. Your account syncs across all devices. Log in with the same credentials on any phone, tablet, or computer.

q3.question: How do I add a new team member?
q3.answer: Go to Settings > Team > Add Member. Enter their email and choose their role. They'll receive an invite to join.

q4.question: What payment methods are supported?
q4.answer: We support credit/debit cards, contactless payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay), and cash. Payment options vary by region.

q5.question: How do I export my sales data?
q5.answer: Go to Reports > Export. Choose your date range and format (CSV or PDF). The file will download to your device.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Dobify uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website or use our services.

section1.title: What Are Cookies
section1.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your experience.

section2.title: Cookies We Use
section2.text: We use the following types of cookies:

item1.name: Essential Cookies
item1.desc: Required for the website to function. They enable core features like security, session management, and accessibility.

item2.name: Analytics Cookies
item2.desc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting anonymous usage data.

item3.name: Preference Cookies
item3.desc: Remember your settings and preferences, such as language and region.

section3.title: Managing Cookies
section3.text: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. However, blocking essential cookies may affect website functionality.

section4.title: Third-Party Cookies
section4.text: Some cookies are placed by third-party services we use, such as analytics providers. These are governed by their respective privacy policies.
